definition: AI-Assisted Debugging is a core concept in Vibe Coding with AI. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What AI-Assisted Debugging is
theory.body: AI-Assisted Debugging describes the methods and patterns used within Vibe Coding with AI to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: AI-Assisted Debugging is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why AI-Assisted Debugging matters
theory.body: Without AI-Assisted Debugging, systems built with Vibe Coding with AI are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How AI-Assisted Debugging works
theory.body: The mechanism behind AI-Assisted Debugging follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of AI-Assisted Debugging.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of AI-Assisted Debugging
theory.body: AI-Assisted Debugging offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
